summary.headline: Astrological Chapter Catalogue, 117–136
summary.text: Catalog of chapters 117–136 in an Angelican astrological codex, covering absent persons, foreign residence, parents’ deaths, rising planetary terms, construction and demolition, voyages, stellar bonds, war, eclipses, planetary motions, Antiochus, fixed-star effects, and passionate places in the zodiac signs.
